scope: SnowForce checkout root-cause redesign, retaining Medusa catalog/orders and existing manual-capture payment semantics unless user selects otherwise

sources.supports: Public cart UI only; no claim about private backend, unavailable live checkout request timing.
Estimated cart costs may change at checkout; not proof Shopify uses this proposed implementation.
Separate prepare/poll operations for shipping rates.
Standalone Tax Calculations separate from tax transactions and payment.

rootCauses: Address edits trigger a synchronous orchestration of native cart mutation, repeated delivery reads, tax withdrawal/normalization/calculation/application and final proof.
Observed one tax request: 147 PostgreSQL spans, 7 Stripe account GETs, 6 settings GETs and 6 registration-list GETs.
Payment-grade modules each independently re-observe shared state; repeated work is compounded by network round trips.

serverOnly: reviewed tax configuration and active registration observation
provider calculation and all returned line breakdowns

server: fresh owned state and payment-state checks
revalidate current item prices, availability, delivery, tax setup and policy
short coherent transaction to normalize/apply one exact quote and persist consent
prepare payment with existing idempotency and manual-capture controls
finalize.onMismatch: Return conflict and require review of changed amounts; no auto-charge
finalize.avoid: Do not replay the full 19-second chain under a different button.

implementationBatches.name: Quote source and draft contract
implementationBatches.changes: Separate server-owned versioned draft and semantic quote binding from applied native cart fingerprint; complete shipping and pickup eligibility.

implementationBatches.name: Read-only preview and responsive UI
implementationBatches.changes: One debounced latest-draft request; superseded responses ignored; local failures do not lock typing or grant payment readiness.

implementationBatches.name: Atomic review and payment compatibility
implementationBatches.changes: Reuse a still-matching provider quote after final validation; consolidate authoritative reads, bounded setup observations, database round trips and native writes; preserve native payment/fulfillment/after-sales checks.

implementationBatches.name: Release and performance acceptance
implementationBatches.changes: Focused security/race tests, root and commerce full tests/builds, isolated provider and native workflow tests, feature flag and rollback, formal first-address/multitab/mobile proof.

performanceTargets.status: proposed acceptance targets, not measured production results or SLA
performanceTargets.preview: p95 <= 2 seconds after debounce for valid address on warm path
performanceTargets.finalReview: p95 <= 3 seconds excluding provider authentication/customer challenge; measure separately
performanceTargets.measurements: At least 30 comparable cold/warm samples per operation, failures included; no-op edits excluded from first-address timing

safety: No removal of inventory, price, ownership, tax-registration, payment-state, quote-expiry or consent checks.
No shared cache of customer carts, amounts or addresses.
No production charges, orders, captures or refunds for this investigation.
No new provider account, infrastructure migration, tax registration or SDK upgrade.
decisionPending: User preference requested: retain SnowForce in-site checkout vs allow Stripe-hosted checkout. No final financial flow switched.
